decision_authority: DEC-010 implementation-agent choice; not separately user-confirmed

hpke.info: ASCII private-rag/delivery/v1 + one zero byte + canonical JSON binding
hpke.aead_aad: empty; single-shot official API binds auxiliary authenticated fields through info
hpke.output: 32-byte enc || 12296-byte encrypted fixed payload || 16-byte authentication tag
hpke.source_authentication: provider mTLS identity and honest server enrollment, no independent HPKE sender signature

binding.uuids: canonical lowercase hyphenated UUIDs, unique per-user per-block opaque slot
binding.encoding: ASCII JSON ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, compact separators, no nonfinite numbers; duplicate/unknown/noncanonical input rejected

resharing.D_to_S: 1537-word fixed payload t_S,m_S,delta_z,delta_e; same offsets; preparation_id publicly bound by management request
resharing.randomness: secrets.randbits(59), independent for each user/block/coordinate/generation; no seeded production option
resharing.preparation_requirement: S native final ACK and durable own-share object plus completed-session registration; matching preparation_id=session UUID; D only retains deliverable share when its private failure bit is false; no public preparation insertion

publication.objects: SHA256 content addressed, 0700 directory, 0600 files, atomic hardlink and fsync; S shares separate from HPKE packages
publication.manifest_digest: SHA256 canonical public JSON excluding manifest_sha256 itself
publication.atomicity: all active authorized users and all blocks validated, one PostgreSQL transaction changes active pointers; unsuccessful publication preserves prior view
publication.retention: objects immutable and retained; snapshots pin delivery rows until terminal state; automated garbage collection not implemented

identity.source: validated TLS peer certificate DER from trusted transport ASGI scope; SHA256 matches enrolled account
identity.admin_enrollment: operator-only Python repository method, no network route
identity.client: TLS1.3-only X25519, CA+hostname verification, Ed25519 server public key; optional exact leaf SHA256 pin; no redirects or environment proxy

vault.D: AES-256-GCM, fresh 96-bit nonce, header PRDV + 00 01, nonce, ciphertext+16-byte tag
vault.keys: strict recognized OS keyring backend, no plaintext file fallback
vault.U: long-term X25519 HPKE keys use separate OS-keyring service
vault.secure_erasure: Python byte copies and OS backend behavior do not establish physical memory erasure

material_ledger.reservation: durable before first use; unique session/operation/kind binding with shape and ring59
material_ledger.crash: reserved entries burned; old sessions aborted after exclusive compute-owner confirmation
material_ledger.terminal_cleanup: release snapshot references only after completed or public abort

actual_checks: records/management_debug.json; records/management_mtls_debug.json; records/compute_process_debug.json; records/scheduler_debug.json; actual HPKE/OS keystore/PostgreSQL/TLS/client binding, public synthetic preparation/lifecycle only; not R2 inference or formal acceptance; records/cancellation_debug.json; records/cancellation_mtls_debug.json (public cancellation/pipe fixtures only)
limitations: No complete private Embedding or generation executed; activation and native full-model gates remain closed
Application/worker/scheduler source wiring implemented; closed-gate and public lifecycle checks do not establish native full-model runtime correctness
No claim of complete RAG, malicious security or formal acceptance
Automatic immutable-object garbage collection remains deferred; no deletion endangers accepted snapshots

recipient_registration.recovery: GET own user_id/key_version/public_key_hex only; no private material
recipient_registration.concurrency: POST expected_previous_version checked under transaction lock; reused prior public key rejected
recipient_registration.uncertain_write: no automatic replay; client reads public state and retains OS private key

synchronization.client: UserClient.synchronize creates fresh verifier and fetches every manifest package each call; no incremental endpoint
synchronization.commit: one immutable complete collection only after all bindings and HPKE authenticate
synchronization.query: accept uses complete manifest digest; every subsequent new query requires fresh complete synchronization

compute_coordinator.socket_lanes: three raw connected TCP lanes compute,C_out,S_out; native mutual TLS checks enrolled account fingerprint and accepted snapshot; no plaintext admission header
compute_coordinator.event_fd: argv20: byte1 authenticated then byte2 releasing; argv21: matching ACK after persistent callback
compute_coordinator.completion: native exit0 includes final release ACK; S prepare object fsync precedes atomic preparation insert+completed; query completed only after worker exit0
compute_coordinator.D_delivery_readiness: both private outcomes perform identical authenticated GET own public session completion waiting before branching on D failure bit; only after completed+release_acknowledged may D locally retain successful own share or return private failure
compute_coordinator.timeout: no total computation deadline; public TCP admission timeout separate; native fixed 30/180 heartbeat
compute_coordinator.one_party: U/C local question and U shares; D/C local chunk and D shares; S only S shares and weights; no two-party merge in application

cancellation.route: POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/cancel; own mTLS account; no secret failure or reason field
cancellation.identity: C preselects random session UUID before acceptance; account-bound durable cancel intent can overtake acceptance; no automatic acceptance replay
cancellation.claim: atomic worker_owner claim/cancel/completion transactions; claimed cancellation retains global active slot until child and three lanes reaped
cancellation.public_only: network/process faults or explicit user cancellation; private numeric outcome never triggers cancel
cancellation.recovery: CLI normal SIGTERM unwinds cleanup; hard kill or database outage requires proven old-worker cleanup; no automatic resume
cancellation.migration: existing active rows conservatively claimed when worker_claimed first added; preserve metadata
